method: Downloaded seven pinned PNG blobs, verified Git object identities and visually inspected each original image using view_image. No execution of illustrated application.
findings: Form screenshot shows eight shortcut profiles, separate name/keys/scope/action fields, expanded delay1900ms and custom %UserProfile%/Documents location; repeated Ctrl+F1 mappings are illustrative, not evidence of conflict resolution.
Preferences screenshot visibly shows five settings with active auto-update/history/restore and inactive theme workaround/hide tray. Status row shows window/reuse/keyboard active and mouse inactive.
Menu screenshot shows keyboard/mouse submenu arrows and window/reuse/startup/update/settings/exit commands, consistent with reviewed tray source.
RestorePrevious screenshot shows Yes/No prompt with Yes visually outlined; visual focus does not prove runtime default key behavior.
TabSearch screenshot presents folder names and full paths with same icon and clear-history button, confirming absence of explicit open/history differentiation in this pictured state.
TheWhy screenshot depicts four separate Explorer taskbar previews, establishing motivating window-management presentation rather than file-content duplicate detection.
Icon PNG is a blue circular application illustration with window, folder/tab and E-key motif. It contains no algorithmic material.
limits: Screenshots are repository illustrations, not current runtime verification, performance evidence, accessibility qualification or proof of library behavior.
Remaining nine GIF animations and one ICO have no visual credit yet. Fully reviewed repository count148/500; ExplorerTabUtility94/104. Native pHash investigation deferred.
